user.title: Rack Display
user.description: Sets up Rack Display. Build your rack afterwards in the rack editor: Settings → Integrations → Rack Display → Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Rack Display is already set up.

init.title: Rack Display
init.description:
**[Open rack editor]({editor})**

In the editor you create the rack, drag devices into rack units, link Home Assistant devices and upload photos.

The display itself is at [{display}]({display}) or as the “Rack Display” card in any dashboard.
